reason: Two parts of the idea split under the feasibility lens. The motion-model part (velocity x(k+1), gates scaled by sqrt(k+1)) is already dead: the research sims measured ~0 after the edge filter. The refined 'ILP-first on post-freeze transitions' is easy to put in the kernel. Raw frames are already in post-processing memory (close_single_frame_gaps takes a frame_cache), and raw/<stem>.geff is the ILP SOLUTION only: every edge has solution=True, out-degree is at most 1 and p is at least 0.48. So seeding is one-to-one, the node ids match the ckpt, and it costs well under 1 s per video. But the proposed lab test cannot run as written. replay.py starts from ckpt/<stem>.npz, the checkpoint taken AFTER the relink and gap closing ('the raw -> ckpt part is NOT replayed: DeepCenter scores exist only at raw nodes'). A change inside motion_relink_edges, before gap closing, therefore has no replayable path. relink_rerun in anatomy.py only rebuilds the relink edge set; it does not rebuild gap1 (DC veto on images) and does not re-feed the tail. Moving it before linefit also changes linefit coordinates, so the cached DaughterNet node p fail the 1e-3 coordinate check. The one form with exact lab/kernel parity is a post-tail patch in the edgefilter slot, and it is largely redundant. Relink edges with p>0 are exactly ILP edges, because the learned probabilities exist only on ILP solution pairs. So every relink edge that conflicts with the ILP has p=0 and is already an edge-filter candidate (max_prob 0.3, alt3). On 6bba post-freeze transitions (791 transitions), the ef candidates hold 34 TP / 487 FP, and ef drops them already. Only 48 TP / 69 FP of relink_new edges have no ILP edge at either end: dropping them (ILPONLY) is worth about +14 net edges, about +0.0001. Of the 13,105 ILP solution edges on post transitions that are absent from the exp39 final graph, 3,460 (26%) have an endpoint the short-track filter or prune has already removed, so a post-tail patch cannot reach them. 467 have both ends free, which is stitch's domain. The remaining 9,178 are blocked by relink_new edges (blocker counts: 8,188 tight / 5,659 relaxed endpoints), which ef already drops and greedily relinks. The research sim's +73 TP / +13 FP came from a per-frame Hungarian on raw nodes, compared against base+ef WITHOUT stitch. It is not shown to survive in any form the lab can test exactly. Expected public gain (0 to +0.0008) is below LB resolution, so the lab is the only judge. The gate also has to be rewritten ('44b6 identical'), and this competes with the x138 port for the last 5 days.
fix_if_any: Test a hybrid replay instead of the as-written patch (about 1 day of CPU-only code, then Kaggle CPU kernels). (1) Build a per-stem frozen list once from np.array_equal on the raw train zarr in a Kaggle CPU kernel. Locally, compare the per-frame compressed chunk bytes instead, which needs no decompression. Do not use the >80%-zero proxy. (2) For each 6bba stem that has freezes, rerun the notebook's motion_relink_edges (the relink_rerun path, validated 98.6%) with the ILP solution edges (raw geff, one-to-one) seeded on post-freeze t. Use FILL for the leftovers. The later transitions' predecessor velocities follow automatically. (3) Splice the result into the ckpt: replace raw-to-raw relink edges on the affected transitions; keep gap1/gap2/safe-div edges unless an endpoint conflicts, in which case drop that synthetic chain. Only 29 evaluable post-freeze edges touch synthetic nodes, which bounds the approximation error at about 0.0002. Then run the normal tail (short-track, leaf prune, linefit), ef and stitch. Report node_p_coord_mismatch for DaughterNet. (4) Control: POSTFREEZE_MODE=0 must be bit-identical, 44b6 71/71 unchanged. Adopt only if 6bba confirmation is >= +0.0008 with CI > 0 ON TOP OF ef+stitch. Ship in the kernel as the in-relink seed (about 30 lines at the _EF_RELINK_ANCHOR, reusing _ef_ilp_probs), using frames from frame_cache. A cheaper fallback with exact parity is a post-tail 'postfreeze' patch: drop every non-ILP edge on post-freeze transitions that conflicts with an ILP edge, then add ILP edges whose two ends are free (two-pass, no skip_forks). Expect about +0.0001 from it, because ef+stitch already cover most of it. If the hybrid shows < +0.0005 over ef+stitch, drop the idea.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0000 to +0.0005 on public. It is 0 if the public embryo has no duplicate frames, and it is not measurable at LB resolution. Locally about +0.0005 to +0.001 on 6bba over ef+stitch at best; the post-tail-only form gives about +0.0001.
